title: ideal-agent made, and the general know-how moved in
done: Created grenudi/ideal-agent with its mark (kind canon, topics oco-project and oco-kind-canon), its tad database (practices, decisions, research, sources, landscape, backlog, session_log; CI checks it with tad's pinned release) and a Claude Code plugin and marketplace: skills, hooks (ideal-agent guard and start, a Rust program declared with argenv, built by the plugin with cargo) and the researcher agent. Moved in the practices, the shared skills, the general hook rules, the role methods and the research and decisions on organising agents; added the keeper of a shared resource at the author's word. Each old place now points here (see backlog move-in).
considered: Proving the guard live before narrowing devlab (orchestration asked for that order); it was proven by giving both guards the same 19 events first and live in a fresh session after.
rejected: A shell guard (fragile reading of shell lines); prebuilt binaries first (backlog release-binaries).
